'''Anti-armor grenades''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] used in combat. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Fenn Shysa]] used anti-armor grenades during the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
